description: Use this when the user wants to offer a good or service for barter on TraydStar. Publishes a public listing on their account and returns its id. Photos can't be attached here; the user can add them on the website. Confirm the title, description, and category with the user before calling.

description.description: What is offered, in the user's words

details.description: Only for Trading Cards and Sneakers listings: the facts collectors trade on. Use the card fields for Trading Cards and the sneaker fields for Sneakers.

box.description: Sneakers: comes with the original box

card_condition.description: Trading Cards: condition of a raw card

card_number.description: Trading Cards: number on the card, e.g. 4/102

cert_number.description: Trading Cards: certification number on the slab label, so the other side can look it up

grade.description: Trading Cards: grade on the slab, e.g. 10 or 9.5

graded.description: Trading Cards: true for a slabbed card (then give grader and grade), false or omitted for raw

grader.description: Trading Cards: grading company of a graded card

model.description: Sneakers: model, e.g. Air Jordan 1 High OG

receipt.description: Sneakers: comes with proof of purchase

set.description: Trading Cards: set or series, e.g. Base Set, 2023 Topps Chrome

size.description: Sneakers: US size, half sizes allowed (needs size_group)

style_code.description: Sneakers: style code from the box or tag

variant.description: Trading Cards: holo, 1st edition, parallel, refractor and so on

draft.description: true saves it unpublished; publish later with set_listing_status

kind.description: offer (default) for something the user has; wanted for something the user is looking for, with want fields describing what they would give

pickup.description: Can be handed over in person (default true)

ships.description: The user will ship it (default false)

stated_value_usd.description: The user's own estimate of its value in US dollars, used to match fair trades

subcategory.description: A subcategory of that category, if one applies. Cameras & Photo: Camera Bodies, Lenses, Film Cameras, Lighting & Flash, Tripods & Support, Bags & Accessories, Video & Drones. Trading Cards: Pokémon, Magic: The Gathering, Yu-Gi-Oh!, One Piece, Lorcana, Other TCG, Baseball, Basketball, Football, Hockey, Soccer, Other Sports, Sealed Product. Sneakers: Jordan, Nike, Adidas, New Balance, Asics, Other Brands. Collectibles: Coins & Currency, Comics, Toys & Figures, LEGO, Vinyl, Sports Memorabilia, Other Collectibles.

title.description: Short name of what is offered

type.description: GOOD for a physical item, SERVICE for work, BOTH if it includes both

want_description.description: What the user would like in exchange

want_tags.description: Short tags for what the user wants in exchange

name: create_listing
title: Create a listing
